\sphinxAtStartPar
This is the documentation of \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{bp\_text}}, which is a Python library containing
tools for algorithmic text generation.

\sphinxAtStartPar
At its core, \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{bp\_text}} is capable of processing various text files contained
in a database (as of now in form of a BibTeX file), analyzing them (e.g. by
tokenizing the PDF\sphinxhyphen{}text) and generating new material from the source text(s).

\sphinxAtStartPar
This project has been initially created for the project \sphinxstyleemphasis{the prospect of its own
undoing} (working title) by Fabian Bentrup and Ruben Philipp.

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
This project is still under active development.  Thus, the API is likely to
change.  Additionally, not all functionality described in parts of this
documentation is implemented.
\end{sphinxadmonition}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is a class implementation of a PDF file.  A PDF file object is related
to an actual PDF file (e.g. retrieved from a database entry).  Its methods
facilitate e.g. the retrieval of data/text from the pages.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The \sphinxtitleref{data} attribute holds the {\hyperref[\detokenize{generated/bp_text.pdf:bp_text.pdf.PdfPage}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PdfPage}}}}} objects.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Examples:

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}\PYGZsh{} load a PDF file and extract the content from its pages}
\PYG{n}{pdfFile} \PYG{o}{=} \PYG{n}{pdf}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{PdfFile}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{l+s+s2}{bajohr2024a.pdf}\PYG{l+s+s2}{\PYGZdq{}}\PYG{p}{,} \PYG{n}{auto\PYGZus{}extract}\PYG{o}{=}\PYG{k+kc}{True}\PYG{p}{)}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}\PYGZsh{} get the primary language}
\PYG{n+nb}{print}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{pdfFile}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{lang}\PYG{p}{)}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}\PYGZsh{} =\PYGZgt{} \PYGZdq{}de\PYGZdq{}}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}\PYGZsh{} get the label from the second page (in this case a roman numeral)}
\PYG{n}{pdfFile}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mi}{1}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{page\PYGZus{}label}
\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}\PYGZsh{} =\PYGZgt{} \PYGZdq{}II\PYGZdq{}}

\PYG{c+c1}{\PYGZsh{}\PYGZsh{} get the text from the third page}
\PYG{n}{pdfFile}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{data}\PYG{p}{[}\PYG{l+m+mi}{2}\PYG{p}{]}\PYG{o}{.}\PYG{n}{text}

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is a class implementation for a PDF page.  A PDF page holds is a
reference to a page in a PDF document, usually related to a
{\hyperref[\detokenize{generated/bp_text.pdf:bp_text.pdf.PdfFile}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{bp\_text.pdf.PdfFile}}}}} object.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The data attribute is also capable of holding a PyPDF2.PageObject
(optional), while the text attribute can contain text retrieved from the
file (e.g. via OCR or direct extraction \textendash{}
cf. {\hyperref[\detokenize{generated/bp_text.pdf:bp_text.pdf.PdfPage.extract_text}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PdfPage.extract\_text()}}}}} or {\hyperref[\detokenize{generated/bp_text.pdf:bp_text.pdf.PdfFile.extract_text}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PdfFile.extract\_text()}}}}}).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{page\_num}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{int}}) \textendash{} The page number (zero\sphinxhyphen{}based) of the page in the related
file.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{page\_label}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{string}}) \textendash{} The actual page label of the page in the PDF file.
The actual PDF page number/label is defined in the PDF header and could
differ from the \sphinxtitleref{page\_num} (e.g. by varying the start index being a
roman instead of an arabic numeral.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{data}} (A \sphinxtitleref{PyPDF2.PageObject}) \textendash{} A \sphinxtitleref{PyPDF2.PageObject}. Default = None

\item {}

\item {}

\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{lang}} (\sphinxstyleliteralemphasis{\sphinxupquote{string}}) \textendash{} The language code of the primary language in the alpha3/ISO
639\sphinxhyphen{}2 form.

\item {}

\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{file}} (A {\hyperref[\detokenize{generated/bp_text.pdf:bp_text.pdf.PdfFile}]{\sphinxcrossref{\sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{PdfFile}}}}} object.) \textendash{} An optional (back\sphinxhyphen{})reference to a PdfFile object.
